engineering_extension.rule: For an insufficient internal segment whose two incident turns have the same sign, replace those two virtual corners by the intersection of their exterior tangent rays. Recompute complete basic/bisected G2CBS, verify all curves and preserve original-index groups.
engineering_extension.limitations: Deterministic greedy candidate only. Does not merge opposite-sign turns or repair collision-only failures. Does not change endpoints/obstacles, apply LOS pruning or replace a tail by RS.
